summary: Iter50 — Shop password feature parity with PM portal. Backend: 12/12 NEW tests PASS in test_iter50_shop_password_parity.py covering /shop/forgot-password (unknown/blank/valid email all return generic 200), /shop/reset-password (bogus → 400, tampered → 400, expired → 400, short pw → 400, valid round-trip → 200 + fresh token, replay-after-rotation → 400), and AdminShopUsersPanel custom-password parity (set-password & email-welcome both honor body.password). Frontend: code review confirms all data-testids wired (shop-forgot-password-link, shop-forgot-dialog, shop-forgot-email-input, shop-forgot-submit, shop-reset-form/new/confirm/submit, shop-change-pw-link on ShopHub, pm-change-pw-link on PmHub). Live Playwright UI assertion of those flows was BLOCKED in this session by the Emergent preview 'Wake up servers' gateway — every fresh browser nav landed on the cartridge wake screen and the form selectors never resolved. Backend is fully responsive (12 tests + raw curl into /shop/login 200 OK with testmech creds), so the gateway is purely a session-layer issue. Main agent can verify UI flows in a regular browser; conditional rendering logic is already correctly implemented per code review.

minor.issue: Endpoint accepts admin-supplied passwords <6 chars (e.g. 'abc') without 400. email-welcome correctly enforces >=6, but set-password has no length floor when password is supplied directly. Low impact — admin-strict endpoint, but mirroring email-welcome's 400 check would be cleaner.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Add `if body.password and len(body.password) < 6: raise HTTPException(400, ...)` in /api/admin/shop-users/{id}/set-password to mirror email-welcome's guardrail.

Main agent please self-verify UI in a fresh browser tab: (1) /shop/login Forgot link → dialog opens, submits, shows generic toast; (2) /shop/reset/<bogus> renders pw fields; (3) login as testmech (or chris wright on PM) → respective Hub shows Change Password button; (4) /admin login → visit /pm → Change Password button HIDDEN. The Emergent preview 'Wake up servers' interstitial blocked Playwright in this session even after clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: make_shop_reset_token / consume_shop_reset_token correctly bind to password_hash[:16] — replay after a successful reset is properly rejected (verified test_valid_token_round_trip_and_replay_blocked).

/api/shop/forgot-password is email-enumeration-safe: identical 200 generic response for unknown emails, blank emails, no-password users, disabled users, and the success path. _record_login_fail() ALSO fires on unknown/blank email so brute-force lockout still applies even on the enumeration-safe path. Good.
/api/shop/reset-password correctly rejects tokens with wrong segment count (token.count('.') != 2) and ValueError on int(exp_str), so malformed tokens never crash the endpoint.

Custom password field on /api/admin/shop-users/{id}/email-welcome works as advertised — when admin passes {password: 'X'}, X is what gets stored AND emailed (verified test_email_welcome_with_custom_password by logging in with the supplied value).

MINOR: set-password lacks a 6-char floor when password is admin-supplied directly. The only consumer that enforces it is email-welcome. UI dialog (AdminShopUsersPanel) currently relies on form-level validation; if a future caller bypasses the UI, weak passwords could be set.

Frontend code review (no live render): ShopLogin.jsx has data-testid='shop-forgot-password-link' next to Remember Me + a working dialog wired to /shop/forgot-password (verified). ShopHub.jsx renders <Link data-testid='shop-change-pw-link'> conditionally on me.user (per-user only) and hides for is_legacy. PmHub.jsx mirrors the pattern. ShopResetPassword.jsx has shop-reset-form/new/confirm/submit and posts to /shop/reset-password.
App.js wiring: /shop/reset/:token route is registered (referenced in files_of_reference and ShopResetPassword.jsx import path resolves).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter50 canonical regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iter50_shop_password_parity.py (12 tests). Run: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && export ADMIN_PASSWORD=$(grep '^ADMIN_PASSWORD=' /app/backend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && export RESEND_API_KEY=$(grep '^RESEND_API_KEY=' /app/backend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter50_shop_password_parity.py -v`. rca of the issue: No bugs found. The single minor code-review note (no length-floor on /set-password admin direct path) is cosmetic — admin-strict endpoint, UI enforces, no exploit vector. Frontend live UI test was prevented by the preview-gateway 'Wake up servers' interstitial — backend was fully reachable via direct API the whole time (12 tests + curl all returned 200), confirming this is a session-layer artifact of the preview environment, not an app issue.
